name: create_business_account
description: Create a new Cliptok business account. Only the admin business account may create accounts.

business_id.description: Application specific unique identifier for the Cliptok business account to create. Must be a non-empty string with alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens only.

account_data.description: Account fields such as username, display_name, profile, analytics, and settings. Omitted fields are populated with defaults.

username.description: The unique username for the Cliptok account.

display_name.description: The display name shown on the account profile.

profile.description: Profile information including bio, follower counts, and website.

followers_count.description: Number of followers for this account.

following_count.description: Number of accounts this user is following.

website.description: The account's website URL if provided.

analytics.description: Performance metrics and engagement data for the account.

total_likes.description: Total number of likes received across all published content for this account.

total_views.description: Total number of views/impressions across all published content for this account.

engagement_rate.description: Engagement rate as a decimal value (e.g., 0.05 represents 5%).

notifications_enabled.description: Whether push notifications are enabled for this account.

ads_enabled.description: Whether advertisements are enabled for this account.

language.description: The primary language setting for the account interface.

name: delete_business_account
description: Delete a Cliptok business account. The admin business account may delete any account except itself; account owners may delete their own account.

business_id.description: Application specific unique identifier for the Cliptok business account to delete. Must be a non-empty string with alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens only.

name: get_business_profile_data
description: Get profile data of a Cliptok account, including analytics and insights. Note: For non admin users, only the user's own account is fully visible, all other accounts are visible with limited fields. If extra fields are requested, they will be omitted.

business_id.description: Application specific unique identifier for the Cliptok account.

fields.description: List of requested fields to include in the response. Defaults to None. Allowed fields: username, display_name, profile, analytics, settings. Must be a non-empty list if provided.

items.description: Field to include in the response.

name: get_business_publish_status
description:
Get the publishing status of a Cliptok video or photo post.

This endpoint allows you to check the current status of a post publishing task,
including whether it has completed successfully or is still in progress.

business_id.description: Application specific unique identifier for the Cliptok account. Must be a non-empty string (min_length=1) with alphanumeric, underscores, and hyphens only.

publish_id.description: Unique identifier for a post publishing task. Must be a non-empty string (min_length=1) with alphanumeric, underscores, and hyphens only.

name: get_current_business_account
description: Get the currently authenticated Cliptok business account.

name: list_business_accounts
description: List and search all available Cliptok business accounts. This method allows you to discover business_id values that can be used with other Cliptok API methods. Note: For non admin users, only the user's own account is fully visible, all other accounts are visible with limited fields. If extra fields are requested, they will be omitted.

search_query.description: Optional search query to filter accounts by username, display_name, or bio. Case-insensitive partial matching.

fields.description:
List of fields to include in the response. If not specified, defaults to all available fields (business_id, username, display_name, profile, analytics, settings). Must be one of the available fields:
Available fields:
- business_id (always included)
- username
- display_name
- profile (includes bio, followers_count, following_count, website if available)
- analytics (includes total_likes, total_views, engagement_rate if available)
- settings (includes notifications_enabled, ads_enabled, language if available)

items.description: Field to include in the response.

limit.description: Maximum number of accounts to return. Defaults to 50, must be between 1 and 100.

offset.description: Number of accounts to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0. Must be non-negative.

name: publish_business_video
description:
Publish a public video post to a Cliptok account.

This endpoint allows you to upload and publish a video to your Cliptok account with various
customization options for the post's visibility and interaction settings.

business_id.description: Application specific unique identifier for the Cliptok account.

video_url.description: URL of the video to be published. Must start with http:// or https://.

tags.description: List of tags for the video.

thumbnail_url.description: URL of the thumbnail for the video. Must start with http:// or https://.

thumbnail_offset.description: Time offset in seconds for video thumbnail.

caption.description: Caption text for the video. Defaults to None.

is_brand_organic.description: Whether the post is organic branded content. Defaults to False.

is_branded_content.description: Whether the post is branded content. Defaults to False.

disable_comment.description: Whether to disable comments. Defaults to False.

disable_duet.description: Whether to disable duet feature. Defaults to False.

disable_stitch.description: Whether to disable stitch feature. Defaults to False.

upload_to_draft.description: Whether to save as draft instead of publishing. Defaults to False.

name: update_business_account
description: Update a Cliptok business account. The admin business account may update any account including analytics; account owners may update their own username, display_name, profile (bio, website), and settings.

business_id.description: Application specific unique identifier for the Cliptok business account to update. Must be a non-empty string with alphanumeric characters, underscores, and hyphens only.

account_data.description: Partial account fields to merge into the existing record. Omitted fields are left unchanged.

username.description: The unique username for the Cliptok account.

display_name.description: The display name shown on the account profile.

profile.description: Profile information including bio, follower counts, and website.

followers_count.description: Number of followers for this account. Only the admin business account may update follower counts.

following_count.description: Number of accounts this user is following. Only the admin business account may update following counts.

website.description: The account's website URL if provided.

analytics.description: Performance metrics and engagement data for the account. Only the admin business account may update analytics.

total_likes.description: Total number of likes received across all published content for this account.

total_views.description: Total number of views/impressions across all published content for this account.

engagement_rate.description: Engagement rate as a decimal value (e.g., 0.05 represents 5%).

notifications_enabled.description: Whether push notifications are enabled for this account.

ads_enabled.description: Whether advertisements are enabled for this account.

language.description: The primary language setting for the account interface.
